Class ShopDetailApplicationServiceTest

java.lang.Object
com.dianping.shopdetail.ShopDetailApplicationServiceTest
class ShopDetailApplicationServiceTest extends java.lang.Object
从已确认的应用入口验证真实任务引擎及降级边界，替换的仅是外部查询能力。
